PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://w3id.org/bricks/context/1.2/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?ahu ?zone ?sensor ?sid WHERE {
  ?ahu rdfs:label "AHU03" .
  ?ahu brick:feeds ?zone .
  ?sensor brick:hasLocation ?zone ; a brick:AirTemperatureSensor .
  ?sensor ref:hasTimeseriesId ?sid .
}

content.text: The sensors seem linked via `brick:hasPoint`/`brick:isPointOf` rather than `hasPart`. Let me investigate the point structure.

input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?point ?class ?zone WHERE {
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point a ?class .
  ?zone brick:isPartOf [] .
} LIMIT 30

input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?zone ?point ?class ?sid WHERE {
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?point .
  ?point a ?class .
  ?zone a brick:VAV .
  OPTIONAL { ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?sid } .
}
